Semantic intents (1)

modify Publish the stable New Relic API and preserve Go delete ordering

The change publishes the 2026-06-01 New Relic API projection and adds a Go-only delete override that retains the legacy SDK parameter order while leaving the bounded REST and language-neutral SDK compatibility candidates empty.

Deterministic coverage: 3 of 3 changed hunks classified. AI inference skipped.

Representative TypeSpec example
specification/newrelic/NewRelicObservability.Management/client.tsp
 @@usage(AccountProperties, Usage.input | Usage.output, "csharp");
 @@usage(OrganizationProperties, Usage.input | Usage.output, "csharp");
 @@usage(PlanDataProperties, Usage.input | Usage.output, "csharp");
+
+// ===== Go delete parameter reorder =====
+// Reorder the delete method parameters for the Go SDK to keep backward compatibility.
+/**
+ * Deletes an existing New Relic monitor resource from your Azure subscription, removing the integration and stopping the observability of your Azure resources through New Relic
+ */
+#suppress "@azure-tools/typespec-azure-resource-manager/arm-resource-operation" "Override to reorder parameters for the Go SDK"
+op newRelicMonitorResourceDelete(
+  ...ApiVersionParameter,
+  ...SubscriptionIdParameter,
+  ...ResourceGroupParameter,
+  ...Azure.ResourceManager.Legacy.Provider,
+
+  /**
+   * User Email.
+   */
+  @query("userEmail")
+  userEmail: string,
+
+  /**
+   * Name of the Monitors resource.
+   */
+  @path
+  monitorName: string,
+): void;
+
+@@override(
+  NewRelicMonitorResources.delete,
+  newRelicMonitorResourceDelete,
+  "go"
+);
